payload.claim: "`saffron cell`, `saffron batch` and `saffron package` run inside two images you build once" implies `package` uses both the cell-base and the proxy image, but `saffron/phases/package.py` never references the proxy at all (no `start_proxy` call, no proxy network leg): it only needs the base image (built as part of `build_cell_image`) and the repo's own image for its gate-only cells and host probe. Stating `package` needs the proxy image is inaccurate and could send an operator to build an image this command never runs.
